problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign parcels to identical delivery trucks. Parcels:
* Parcel 1: size 54 units
* Parcel 2: size 67 units
* Parcel 3: size 48 units
* Parcel 4: size 60 units
* Parcel 5: size 34 units
* Parcel 6: size 35 units
* Parcel 7: size 63 units
* Parcel 8: size 32 units
* Parcel 9: size 34 units
* Parcel 10: size 44 units
* Parcel 11: size 38 units
* Parcel 12: size 32 units
* Parcel 13: size 49 units
* Parcel 14: size 30 units

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 units. Assign all parcels using the minimum number of trucks. Every parcel must be placed in exactly one truck, and the total size of parcels in any truck cannot exceed its capacity.
